catmech: Auditable Model-Based Imputation and Category Sensitivity

Source: R/catmech-package.R
catmech-package.Rd

Auditable completion of a continuous measurement using Gaussian models, predictive mean matching, an explicitly measured internal reference subset, or a reference-calibrated contamination model of the recorded values. Supports flag masking, optional exact or fallible interval categories, posterior draws and per-record corruption probabilities, convergence and donor-support diagnostics, reference hold-out checks, finite-scenario sensitivity comparisons and 'mice' analysis adapters. Retains a separate retain-or-replace sensitivity engine. Implements multiple-imputation combining rules and finite-sample degrees of freedom following Rubin (1987) doi:10.1002/9780470316696 and Barnard and Rubin (1999) doi:10.1093/biomet/86.4.948 , and an unvalidated audit-size planning aid based on the two-phase sampling theory of Neyman (1938) doi:10.1080/01621459.1938.10503378 . Does not identify measurement error without assumptions or reference information, or guarantee coverage under misspecification.
